SELECT "id", "invoice_number", "supplier_id", "po_id", "status", "total_amount", "currency", "invoice_date", "due_date", "received_at", "match_score", "discrepancy_count", "owner_id", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at", count(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM {{table:invoices}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("invoice_number"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("notes"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($7::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($7::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN $5::text = 'invoice_number' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "invoice_number" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'invoice_number' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "invoice_number" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'total_amount' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "total_amount" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'total_amount' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "total_amount" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'invoice_date' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "invoice_date" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'invoice_date' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "invoice_date" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'due_date' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "due_date" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'due_date' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "due_date" END DESC, id DESC
LIMIT $4::int OFFSET ((($3::int - 1) * $4::int))

SELECT "id", "invoice_number", "supplier_id", "po_id", "status", "total_amount", "currency", "invoice_date", "due_date", "received_at", "match_score", "discrepancy_count", "owner_id", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
FROM {{table:invoices}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("invoice_number"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("notes"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($3::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($3::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 5000

SELECT "id", "invoice_number", "supplier_id", "po_id", "status", "total_amount", "currency", "invoice_date", "due_date", "received_at", "match_score", "discrepancy_count", "owner_id", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:invoices}} WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO {{table:invoices}} ("invoice_number", "supplier_id", "po_id", "status", "total_amount", "currency", "invoice_date", "due_date", "received_at", "match_score", "discrepancy_count", "owner_id", "notes", created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1::text, $2::int, $3::int, $4::text, $5::numeric, $6::text, $7::date, $8::date, $9::timestamptz, $10::int, $11::int, $12::int, $13::text, now(), now())
RETURNING "id", "invoice_number", "supplier_id", "po_id", "status", "total_amount", "currency", "invoice_date", "due_date", "received_at", "match_score", "discrepancy_count", "owner_id", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"

UPDATE {{table:invoices}}
SET "invoice_number" = $2::text, "supplier_id" = $3::int, "po_id" = $4::int, "status" = $5::text, "total_amount" = $6::numeric, "currency" = $7::text, "invoice_date" = $8::date, "due_date" = $9::date, "received_at" = $10::timestamptz, "match_score" = $11::int, "discrepancy_count" = $12::int, "owner_id" = $13::int, "notes" = $14::text, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL
RETURNING "id", "invoice_number", "supplier_id", "po_id", "status", "total_amount", "currency", "invoice_date", "due_date", "received_at", "match_score", "discrepancy_count", "owner_id", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
UPDATE {{table:invoices}} SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:invoices}} SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:invoices}} SET "status" = $2::text, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "status"

SELECT count(*)::int AS total, coalesce(sum("total_amount"), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS total_value, coalesce(avg("total_amount"), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS average_value, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'received')::int AS status_received, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'matching')::int AS status_matching, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'exception')::int AS status_exception, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'approved')::int AS status_approved, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'scheduled')::int AS status_scheduled, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'paid')::int AS status_paid, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "status" = 'void')::int AS status_void
FROM {{table:invoices}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (NULLIF($1::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($1::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at)::date AS day, count(*)::int AS count, coalesce(sum("total_amount"), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS total
FROM {{table:invoices}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= coalesce(NULLIF($1::text, '')::date, now() - interval '90 days')
  AND created_at < (coalesce(NULLIF($2::text, '')::date, now()::date) + interval '1 day')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT "status" AS status, count(*)::int AS count FROM {{table:invoices}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (NULLIF($1::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($1::text, '')::date) AND (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date + interval '1 day')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
